unattended-death-cleanup.title: Unattended Death Cleanup
unattended-death-cleanup.sub: Discreet, compassionate cleanup and decontamination after an unattended death.
intros: When a death goes undiscovered for hours, days, or longer, the affected area requires professional biohazard remediation — not ordinary cleaning. Bodily fluids and decomposition byproducts can penetrate flooring, subfloor, and structural materials and pose real health risks.
Peak Bio-Clean responds quickly and quietly, treating both the property and your family with the dignity the situation deserves. We handle the entire process so loved ones never have to.
incl: Full assessment of affected porous and non-porous materials
Safe removal and disposal of contaminated items
Odor neutralization at the molecular level

crime-scene-cleanup.title: Crime Scene Cleanup
crime-scene-cleanup.sub: Certified remediation of crime scenes once authorities have released the property.
intros: After law enforcement completes their work, the cleanup is left to the property owner or family. Peak Bio-Clean steps in to restore the scene safely, removing blood, bodily fluids, and other biohazards in full compliance with OSHA and state regulations.
Our technicians are trained to work methodically and respectfully, returning the space to a safe, sanitary condition.
incl: Fingerprint powder and chemical residue cleanup

biohazard-waste-disposal.title: Biohazard Waste Disposal
biohazard-waste-disposal.sub: Licensed pickup, transport, and disposal of regulated biohazardous waste.
intros: Biohazardous and infectious waste cannot be thrown away with ordinary trash — it must be handled, transported, and destroyed under strict federal and state rules. Peak Bio-Clean is equipped and certified to do exactly that.
From a single contaminated cleanup to large-scale waste removal, we take everything safely and legally, sparing you the liability and the hassle.

trauma-cleanup.title: Trauma Cleanup
trauma-cleanup.sub: Professional cleanup and restoration after a traumatic incident.
intros: Traumatic events — accidents, medical emergencies, and violent incidents — can leave behind blood and biohazards that require specialized handling. Peak Bio-Clean restores the affected area so you don't have to face it alone.
We arrive 24/7, work with compassion and discretion, and coordinate directly with your insurance whenever possible.

suicide-cleanup.title: Compassionate & Discreet Suicide Cleanup
suicide-cleanup.sub: Respectful, confidential cleanup so families can begin to heal.
intros: Few situations are more painful than the loss of a loved one to suicide. Peak Bio-Clean handles the cleanup with the utmost compassion and discretion, allowing your family the space to grieve.
Our trained technicians remove all biohazards, fully decontaminate the area, and restore the space — quietly and respectfully.

decomposition-cleanup.title: Decomposition Cleanup
decomposition-cleanup.sub: Thorough decontamination and odor removal after human or animal decomposition.
intros: Decomposition releases fluids, bacteria, and powerful odors that soak into porous materials and spread through a structure. Surface cleaning is never enough. Peak Bio-Clean performs complete remediation down to the source.
We identify every affected material, remove what cannot be saved, and treat the area until it is safe and odor-free.

blood-cleanup.title: Blood Cleanup
blood-cleanup.sub: Safe, OSHA-compliant blood and bodily-fluid cleanup.
intros: Blood is a potential carrier of bloodborne pathogens such as HIV and hepatitis, and it must be handled with proper training and protective equipment. Peak Bio-Clean removes and disinfects blood safely and completely.
Whether from an accident, injury, or medical event, we restore the area to a sanitary condition.

hoarding-cleanup.title: Hoarding Cleanup
hoarding-cleanup.sub: Compassionate, organized clean-outs that restore safe, livable spaces.
intros: Hoarding situations often involve biohazards, structural concerns, and deeply personal belongings. Peak Bio-Clean approaches every clean-out with patience, respect, and zero judgment.
We work alongside families and individuals to sort, remove, sanitize, and restore the home to a safe and livable condition.
incl: Sorting and removal of clutter and waste
Coordination with families and case managers

rodent-waste-removal.title: Rodent Waste Removal
rodent-waste-removal.sub: Cleanup and decontamination of rodent droppings, nesting, and contamination.
intros: Rodent droppings and urine can carry serious diseases such as hantavirus and salmonella, and disturbing them improperly can release airborne contaminants. Peak Bio-Clean removes and decontaminates rodent waste safely.
We clean affected areas, sanitize surfaces, and help prevent the spread of contamination.

sewage-cleanup.title: Sewage Cleanup
sewage-cleanup.sub: Fast extraction and decontamination of sewage backups and spills.
intros: A sewage backup is more than a mess — it's a biohazard. Raw sewage carries bacteria, viruses, and parasites that demand professional remediation. Peak Bio-Clean responds quickly to extract, sanitize, and dry the affected area.
We mitigate damage fast to protect your property and your health.

urine-and-feces-cleanup.title: Urine & Feces Cleanup
urine-and-feces-cleanup.sub: Decontamination of urine and feces from homes, properties, and vehicles.
intros: Accumulated urine and feces — whether from animals, neglect, or hoarding situations — pose genuine health hazards and stubborn odors. Peak Bio-Clean fully decontaminates and deodorizes the affected space.
We treat the contamination at the source so the area is truly safe again.

homeless-camp-cleanup.title: Homeless Encampment Cleanup
homeless-camp-cleanup.sub: Safe, respectful cleanup and biohazard removal at encampment sites.
intros: Encampment sites often contain biohazards, sharps, and hazardous waste that require trained handling. Peak Bio-Clean cleans and decontaminates these areas for property owners and managers.
We work safely and respectfully, restoring the property to a usable condition.

gross-filth-cleanup.title: Gross Filth Cleanup
gross-filth-cleanup.sub: Restoration of severely neglected or unsanitary properties.
intros: When a property has fallen into severe disrepair and unsanitary conditions, it requires far more than standard cleaning. Peak Bio-Clean handles gross-filth situations with the right equipment, training, and care.
We remove waste and contamination, sanitize thoroughly, and restore the space to a safe, livable standard.

infectious-disease-cleanup.title: Infectious Disease Cleanup
infectious-disease-cleanup.sub: Disinfection and decontamination to control infectious-disease exposure.
intros: Infectious diseases can linger on surfaces and spread quickly without proper disinfection. Peak Bio-Clean uses hospital-grade products and EPA-approved protocols to decontaminate affected spaces.
We help homes, businesses, and facilities reduce the risk of exposure and return to safe operation.

medical-waste-cleanup.title: Medical Waste Cleanup
medical-waste-cleanup.sub: Compliant handling and disposal of regulated medical waste.
intros: Medical waste — sharps, contaminated supplies, and infectious materials — is governed by strict regulations. Peak Bio-Clean collects, transports, and disposes of it in full compliance.
We serve clinics, facilities, and residences that need safe, documented medical-waste handling.

smoke-damage-cleanup.title: Smoke Damage Cleanup
smoke-damage-cleanup.sub: Cleanup, deodorizing, and restoration after smoke and soot damage.
intros: Smoke and soot leave behind corrosive residue and persistent odor that spread far beyond the burn area. Peak Bio-Clean cleans, deodorizes, and restores smoke-damaged spaces.
We address residue at the source and neutralize odor so your property feels whole again.

vehicle-cleanup.title: Private & Emergency Vehicle Cleanup
vehicle-cleanup.sub: Biohazard decontamination of personal and emergency vehicles.
intros: Vehicles can be the site of accidents, medical events, or biohazard exposure. Peak Bio-Clean decontaminates cars, trucks, and emergency vehicles safely and thoroughly.
We restore the interior to a clean, sanitary, and safe condition.

covid-19-cleanup.title: COVID-19 Cleanup
covid-19-cleanup.sub: Disinfection of homes and businesses for COVID-19 and other viruses.
intros: Viral contamination requires proper disinfection to reduce the risk of spread. Peak Bio-Clean uses EPA-approved products and proven protocols to sanitize homes and workplaces.
We help you reopen and return to daily life with confidence.

accident-cleanup.title: Accident Cleanup
accident-cleanup.sub: Safe cleanup and decontamination after accidents and injuries.
intros: Accidents at home, at work, or on the road can leave behind blood and biohazards that require proper, safe handling. Peak Bio-Clean responds quickly to clean and decontaminate the area.
We work with compassion and discretion, and coordinate with your insurance whenever possible.

homicide-cleanup.title: Homicide Cleanup
homicide-cleanup.sub: Discreet, certified cleanup after a homicide once the scene is released.
intros: After investigators finish their work, the cleanup is left to the family or property owner. Peak Bio-Clean restores the scene safely, removing blood and biohazards in full compliance with OSHA and state regulations.
Our technicians work methodically, respectfully, and confidentially.

commercial-biohazard-cleanup.title: Commercial Biohazard Cleanup
commercial-biohazard-cleanup.sub: Biohazard cleanup for businesses, offices, and facilities.
intros: Businesses face biohazard situations too, from accidents to infectious contamination. Peak Bio-Clean provides discreet, compliant cleanup with minimal disruption to your operations.
We respond 24/7 and document everything for your records and liability protection.

tear-gas-cleanup.title: Tear Gas Cleanup
tear-gas-cleanup.sub: Removal and decontamination of tear gas and chemical residue.
intros: Tear gas leaves behind chemical residue that clings to surfaces and irritates the eyes, skin, and lungs. Peak Bio-Clean safely removes residue from homes, businesses, and vehicles.
We ventilate, clean, and decontaminate so the space is safe to occupy again.

drug-lab-cleanup.title: Drug Lab Cleanup
drug-lab-cleanup.sub: Certified decontamination of former drug-production sites.
intros: Illegal drug labs leave behind toxic chemicals and residue that pose serious health risks. Peak Bio-Clean is equipped to safely decontaminate and restore these properties.
We follow strict protocols to make the property safe and compliant.

meth-lab-cleanup.title: Meth Lab Cleanup
intros: Methamphetamine production contaminates surfaces, ventilation, and structural materials with toxic residue. Peak Bio-Clean decontaminates the property to safe, compliant standards.
We remove residue at the source and verify the space is safe.

meth-lab-testing.title: Meth Lab Testing
meth-lab-testing.sub: Surface testing to detect and confirm meth contamination.
intros: Before buying, renting, or remediating a property, meth residue testing reveals whether contamination is present. Peak Bio-Clean performs accurate surface sampling and reporting.
Results guide a clear plan for decontamination if needed.

water-removal.title: Water Removal & Extraction
water-removal.sub: Fast removal of standing water to limit damage.
intros: Standing water spreads fast and causes structural damage and mold within hours. Peak Bio-Clean extracts water quickly and begins drying immediately.
We respond 24/7 to protect your property and reduce loss.

water-damage-cleanup.title: Water Damage Cleanup & Repair
water-damage-cleanup.sub: Complete water damage cleanup, drying, and restoration.
intros: From burst pipes to leaks and floods, water damage requires fast, thorough mitigation. Peak Bio-Clean extracts water, dries the structure, and restores damaged areas.
We handle the full process and work directly with your insurance.

flood-cleanup.title: Flood Cleanup
flood-cleanup.sub: Rapid cleanup and sanitizing after flooding.
intros: Floodwater carries contaminants and saturates everything it touches. Peak Bio-Clean removes water, sanitizes affected areas, and dries the structure to prevent mold.
We respond fast to limit damage to your home or business.

flood-restoration.title: Flood Restoration
intros: After the water is gone, properties need drying, decontamination, and rebuilding. Peak Bio-Clean restores flood-damaged homes and businesses to pre-loss condition.
We manage the process from cleanup through repairs.

water-damage-mold-removal.title: Water Damage Mold Removal
water-damage-mold-removal.sub: Mold removal and prevention after water damage.
intros: Lingering moisture from water damage leads to mold growth that threatens health and structure. Peak Bio-Clean dries the source and safely removes mold.
We treat affected areas and help prevent regrowth.

fire-damage-cleanup.title: Fire Damage Cleanup & Repair
fire-damage-cleanup.sub: Cleanup, deodorizing, and repair after fire damage.
intros: Fire leaves behind soot, corrosive residue, smoke odor, and water damage from firefighting. Peak Bio-Clean cleans, deodorizes, and restores fire-damaged properties.
We handle everything from soot removal to rebuilding.

mold-remediation.title: Mold Remediation & Removal
mold-remediation.sub: Safe containment and removal of mold growth.
intros: Mold spreads through moisture and can cause health problems and structural damage. Peak Bio-Clean contains and removes mold using EPA-approved methods.
We address the moisture source and prevent it from returning.

mold-damage-restoration.title: Mold Damage Restoration
mold-damage-restoration.sub: Restoration of properties damaged by mold.
intros: Severe mold can ruin drywall, flooring, and other materials. Peak Bio-Clean removes mold and restores affected areas to a healthy, sound condition.
We rebuild what is damaged and restore healthy indoor air.

storm-damage-cleanup.title: Storm Damage Cleanup
storm-damage-cleanup.sub: Fast cleanup and stabilization after storms.
intros: Storms leave behind debris, water intrusion, and structural hazards. Peak Bio-Clean clears debris, extracts water, and secures your property quickly.
We respond 24/7 to limit further damage.

storm-damage-restoration.title: Storm Damage Restoration
intros: After the storm passes, properties need drying, repairs, and rebuilding. Peak Bio-Clean restores storm-damaged homes and businesses to pre-storm condition.
We manage cleanup through full restoration.

hurricane-damage-cleanup.title: Hurricane Damage Cleanup
hurricane-damage-cleanup.sub: Rapid hurricane cleanup, water removal, and board-up.
intros: Hurricanes bring wind, water, and debris damage that demand a fast response. Peak Bio-Clean removes debris and water and stabilizes your property.
We are available 24/7 across Florida before and after the storm.

hurricane-restoration.title: Hurricane Restoration
intros: Hurricane damage often requires extensive drying, decontamination, and rebuilding. Peak Bio-Clean restores affected properties to pre-storm condition.
We handle the entire recovery process.

deep-cleaning.title: Deep Cleaning
deep-cleaning.sub: Detailed deep cleaning and disinfection for any space.
intros: Some spaces need far more than routine cleaning. Peak Bio-Clean provides thorough deep cleaning and disinfection for homes and businesses.
We sanitize top to bottom for a fresh, healthy space.

rental-deep-cleaning.title: Rental Property Deep Cleaning
rental-deep-cleaning.sub: Turnover deep cleaning to get units rent-ready.
intros: Between tenants, rental units often need a deep reset. Peak Bio-Clean sanitizes and refreshes properties so they are clean and rent-ready fast.
We handle messes routine cleaners cannot.

move-cleaning.title: Move-Out / Move-In Cleaning
move-cleaning.sub: Complete cleaning for moving in or out.
intros: Moving is stressful enough without the cleaning. Peak Bio-Clean fully cleans and sanitizes the space so it is spotless and move-ready.
Perfect for tenants, owners, and property managers.

estate-cleanout.title: Estate & Property Cleanout
estate-cleanout.sub: Complete cleanout of estates and properties after a loss or sale.
intros: After a death, downsizing, or sale, an entire property often needs to be cleared, cleaned, and readied. Peak Bio-Clean handles the full cleanout with care and discretion.
We sort, remove, dispose, donate, and deep-clean so the property is ready for its next step.

odor-removal.title: Odor Removal & Deodorization
odor-removal.sub: Elimination of stubborn odors at the molecular source.
intros: Powerful odors from death, smoke, pets, mold, or waste soak into porous materials, and standard cleaning cannot remove them. Peak Bio-Clean neutralizes odor at the source.
We use industrial deodorizing methods to restore fresh, breathable air.

eviction-cleanout.title: Eviction Cleanout
eviction-cleanout.sub: Fast, thorough cleanout of units after an eviction.
intros: Evicted units are often left with abandoned belongings, damage, and biohazards. Peak Bio-Clean clears, cleans, and sanitizes the space so you can re-rent quickly.
We work discreetly with landlords and property managers.
incl: Removal of abandoned property and debris

vandalism-cleanup.title: Vandalism & Graffiti Cleanup
vandalism-cleanup.sub: Cleanup and restoration after vandalism and graffiti.
intros: Vandalism and graffiti damage your property and your image. Peak Bio-Clean removes graffiti, cleans damage, and restores your property quickly.
We respond fast to help homes and businesses recover.

animal-waste-removal.title: Animal Waste & Deceased Animal Removal
animal-waste-removal.sub: Removal and decontamination of animal waste and deceased animals.
intros: Animal droppings, urine, and deceased animals carry disease and strong odors. Peak Bio-Clean safely removes and decontaminates the affected area.
We sanitize, deodorize, and help prevent contamination from spreading.

nicotine-odor-removal.title: Nicotine & Cigarette Smoke Residue Removal
nicotine-odor-removal.sub: Removal of nicotine residue and cigarette smoke odor.
intros: Years of smoking leave tar, nicotine residue, and stubborn odor on walls, ceilings, and surfaces. Peak Bio-Clean removes residue and neutralizes the smell.
Ideal for rentals, resale homes, and vehicles.

chemical-spill-cleanup.title: Chemical Spill Cleanup
chemical-spill-cleanup.sub: Safe containment and cleanup of hazardous chemical spills.
intros: Chemical spills pose serious safety and environmental risks that require trained handling. Peak Bio-Clean contains, removes, and decontaminates spills safely.
We follow strict protocols and dispose of materials in compliance.

industrial-accident-cleanup.title: Industrial & Workplace Accident Cleanup
industrial-accident-cleanup.sub: Biohazard cleanup after workplace and industrial accidents.
intros: Workplace accidents can leave blood, biohazards, and hazardous materials that must be handled to OSHA standards. Peak Bio-Clean restores the site safely and quickly.
We help businesses reopen with minimal downtime.

attic-crawlspace-decontamination.title: Attic & Crawl Space Decontamination
attic-crawlspace-decontamination.sub: Cleanup and decontamination of attics and crawl spaces.
intros: Attics and crawl spaces collect rodent waste, mold, and contamination that affect your home's air and safety. Peak Bio-Clean cleans and decontaminates these hard-to-reach areas.
We remove contamination, sanitize, and help prevent it from returning.

junk-debris-removal.title: Junk & Debris Removal
junk-debris-removal.sub: Hauling and disposal of junk, clutter, and debris.
intros: Whether from a cleanout, renovation, or storm, piles of junk and debris need to go. Peak Bio-Clean removes and disposes of it responsibly.
We handle heavy loads and haul everything away.

jail-cell-cleanup.title: Jail & Detention Cell Cleanup
jail-cell-cleanup.sub: Biohazard cleanup and decontamination of holding and detention cells.
intros: Holding cells and detention facilities require regular biohazard decontamination for blood, bodily fluids, and infectious materials. Peak Bio-Clean provides compliant, discreet service.
We help facilities maintain safe, sanitary conditions.
